_how_to_use: The guaranteed channel for Future Universities Alliance posts. When a new FUA Substack post arrives in your inbox, add an entry to the 'posts' list below (title, link, date as YYYY-MM-DD, optional summary) and commit. It appears in the Startups channel on the next nightly sweep and stays for 30 days. Old entries can be deleted whenever - anything past 30 days is ignored automatically.
